declarations.docstring: To prove a predicate for every algebra element, it suffices to check both generators and scalars and to preserve addition and multiplication.
The module action induced by endomorphisms satisfying the displayed commutation relation extends the scalar tower from the coefficient ring.
Endomorphisms satisfying the displayed commutation relation induce a module structure over the associated algebra.
Scalar multiplication by an algebra element agrees with evaluation of its induced endomorphism action.
The algebra homomorphism into module endomorphisms induced by a pair satisfying the displayed commutation relation.
The induced endomorphism action sends the first distinguished generator to the first given endomorphism.
The induced endomorphism action sends the second distinguished generator to the second given endomorphism.
